notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1 is released.

Level balance:
 - level with a lot of phones is made a bit easier and optimized

Bug fixes:
 - papers and speedloader no longer fall through the table after unpausing
 - phone calls no longer stop after contact with any phone base
